knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Appendix C: the notice must be placed right beside the spa where bathers can read it before entering.
Appendix C bather warning notice: keep your head out of the water.
Appendix C bather warning notice: keep any single soak to less than 20 minutes.

practicalCriteria: On a supplied spa, checks the notice is right beside the entry, legible and complete, and records the result.
Refuses entry to a supplied bather who is unwell or an unsupervised child, and records the refusal.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Spa daily check record with notice status
Refusal or incident record in a supplied scenario
stopWorkCriteria: Warning notice missing or illegible: do not open the spa until it is replaced.
Unsupervised child in the spa: clear the spa or secure supervision before continuing.
Bather showing signs of distress or heat stress: remove them from the spa and call for help.
